description: Single-seed 25000-round confirmation run for the combined Task 2 V5/V3.7 candidate. Feature V5 preserves V4's D4-canonical safety, coin-target, and exact-best bomb-target masks plus bomb availability, but removes coin-distance and bomb-quality classes from the Q-state; the original classes remain available only for evaluation diagnostics. Reward V3.7 preserves V3.6's mutually exclusive hierarchy and all other values, while changing the direct invalid-action penalty from -0.20 to -0.70 and the selected local BFS bomb-target reward from +0.10 to +0.20; the skipped-target penalty remains -0.20. Epsilon reaches 0.05 after 17500 rounds and remains there for the final 7500 rounds. Five-step TD targets, action space, visit-decay learning rate, gamma, checkpoint interval, seeds, and evaluation protocol match the V4/V3.6 25000-round experiment. Multiple ranked bomb targets are deliberately excluded for this controlled pre-expansion test.
